notes.note: #187 accepted-release record review (branch fix/update-key-pin-187, merged with main 154624a872). install.sh now carries a generated ACCEPTED RELEASE PROGRAM block (packages/shared/src/accepted-release.mjs) plus check_accepted_release/record_accepted_release and a nothing-to-do seed; the installer refuses a public manifest older than the install root's .station-release-accepted.json unless STATION_VERSION + STATION_INSTALL_ALLOW_ROLLBACK=1. Edited the Server source check bullet: an archive's check now also does not offer a manifest older than the release that install already accepted. The day-counter and versioned-asset claims are unchanged; the record accepts any N, so legacy and dated YYYYMMDDBB nightly numbers both order correctly (parity tests).
